text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, which event are you looking forward to?
I gotta go with 'Hyper Jump'~.”

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Spectator B
text_block_list.text: The girl I used to root for is leading the 1st Stage 'Gigantic Throw,' y'know. Personally, I've got my eyes on her.

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"We get to see her in action again...!
Haaah~, I can't wait...!"

text_block_list.name: U.A.F. Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
“—I only started watching for the Tracen girls,
but the other racers are pretty fierce too...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One could clearly see that far more spectators
had turned up for the Qualifiers' 2nd Stage
than during the 1st Stage...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —The stream is much livelier than the previous tournament, which is truly wonderful to see.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "...This is all thanks to the help of my Trainers."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I will do everything in my power
to ensure we provide the finest management possible.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
—Do your best today as well, okay?"
